gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-trirong: Bold and blunt up top, with no stroke thinner than another. Trirong follows in a dignified, bookish serif whose gently flared curves keep a long page moving without snagging the eye.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-trocchi: Comic Relief draws its letters like rods, with bowls left open on one side and no carved edges anywhere. Trocchi then reads as a classic serif with a wide ring of a c, its rounded tops thinning softly across a long page.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-trykker: Trykker has the faint heft shifts of a stone-carved inscription, refined and literary. Over a long passage it breathes easily, while Comic Relief above it stays as uniform as drawn wire.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-uchen: Uchen reads as a dignified serif with welcoming curves and a mild, middle-ground stroke. Under Comic Relief's steady pen pressure, a longer passage settles into a refined, easy rhythm where the curves run slightly heavier than the joins.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-vollkorn-sc: Literary and dignified, Vollkorn SC sets its mild, medium-contrast serif strokes with loose tracking. And Comic Relief, with no thick or thin parts in any letter, earns its keep in big, short headings.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-yuji-syuku: Comic Relief looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, bold and a little unfinished at the bowls. Yuji Syuku is the classic serif here, with open spacing and curves that run slightly heavier than the joins, built for authority rather than punch.
gen-gf-comic-relief-ibm-plex-serif: Chunky, wire-bent curves up top, with an s that never thins at the spine. And IBM Plex Serif, with slimmer horizontals and medium-low contrast, handles the text; give Comic Relief the larger size.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Coming Soon looks scribbled with pen and paper, its lowercase rising close to the capitals. Be Vietnam Pro takes over like bent steel rod, with a high mean line and curve endings that never crowd, so a long passage stays tidy.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-bespoke-sans: Round, marker-like o shapes with lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals set the tone for Coming Soon. And Bespoke Sans, sharper and more moderate in height, gives those loose handwritten letters a crisp, spacious partner.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-literata: Literata reads as a sophisticated, bookish classic serif, its sturdy thin lines and open curved mouths carrying a long page with ease. Coming Soon traces casual marker letters; Literata does the settled work.
